title: Start using Movcues
supportedFunctionality: Set up your workspace and site, then follow a path to your first published experience.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: No new account created; onboarding verified in UI handlers and API contracts.

title: Connect and verify your site
supportedFunctionality: Find your installation snippet and confirm the SDK is running without opening developer tools.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Events explorer is custom-event-only; existing SDK Installation page retains an older page-view verification instruction (not rewritten in this task).

title: Build your first experience
supportedFunctionality: Create a focused onboarding guide, choose its audience, and prepare it for a controlled launch.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: No signed-in end-to-end publish; product example and product button are explicitly fictional.

title: Understand your first results
supportedFunctionality: Check delivery and engagement, then connect experience results to a meaningful product milestone.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: No configured goal conversion; no causal claim from observed changes.

title: Read experience performance
supportedFunctionality: Understand the Experience Overview and the differences between viewers, engagement, and completion.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Top totals add per-experience counts; table filters do not scope top summary/trend. Goal conversion unavailable.

title: Create and manage a dashboard
supportedFunctionality: Save a reusable set of analytics cards for your site and keep its layout organized.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Cards require Save dashboard after Save card; viewing filters are not persisted as defaults.

title: Add and configure analytics cards
supportedFunctionality: Choose Metrics, Funnel, Retention, or Experiences cards and preview the question each one answers.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Match ALL varies by metric and time bucket; no ordered-event meaning. Experience card breakdown metrics are type-dependent.

title: Understand metrics and retention
supportedFunctionality: Read unique users, session duration, conversion rates, and retention with the right definitions.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Historical identity uses event snapshot; retention first start is within selected period; current-segment comparisons are not historical membership. D0 may include starting event.

title: Apply dashboard filters
supportedFunctionality: Change date range, granularity, audience, and excluded events without changing the saved analysis.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Experience cards apply only date range; Funnel cards apply date range/audience, not granularity or exclusions.

title: Create a segment
supportedFunctionality: Group users by recorded actions, page visits, or account properties and verify the matching audience.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Owner/Admin required despite ungated frontend create button. Requires recorded custom events or existing properties.

title: Combine segment conditions
supportedFunctionality: Understand ALL, ANY, nested groups, time windows, and the differences between event, property, and page rules.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Property conditions use identified users; numeric comparison requires numeric stored type. Negative conditions use site-known identities.

title: Review and manage segment membership
supportedFunctionality: Inspect matching users, change a segment safely, and understand why its audience changes.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Membership is evaluated from current data and rolling windows, not stored as a historical list.

title: Create an ordered funnel
supportedFunctionality: Choose meaningful event or page steps and a conversion window for a real product journey.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Saved dashboard funnels differ from SDK defineFunnel; UI and backend step validation checked.

title: Read conversion and drop-off
supportedFunctionality: Understand the funnel denominator, step order, conversion window, and analysis period.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Earliest entry anchors one progression; strict increasing timestamps; later steps can extend beyond entry period. Backend caps event rows per step at 50,000 (internal performance gap).

title: Create a segment from funnel results
supportedFunctionality: Turn reached-step, completed-funnel, or dropped-after-step results into a reusable audience.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Relative vs absolute scope and selected Segment definition copied; current referenced funnel edits can affect membership.

title: Define pages and matching rules
supportedFunctionality: Group recorded URL paths into named Pages, test rules, and reuse them for funnels and targeting.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Area is a free-form classification, not a selectable DOM region; experience page rules are copied, while segments/funnels reference Pages. Heatmaps unavailable.

title: Explore product events
supportedFunctionality: Find custom actions, inspect their properties and occurrences, and follow them to users or sessions.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Custom events only; no event property editing/reprocessing or automatic-click event listing claimed.

title: Inspect a visitor session
supportedFunctionality: Follow recorded page visits and actions in a session timeline without assuming a replay is available.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Session timeline supported; active replay route absent. Multi-select page/device UI sends only first selection, documented use-one guidance.

title: Find users and understand their activity
supportedFunctionality: Browse identified accounts and anonymous visitors, inspect properties, and follow activity into sessions.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Anonymous list has no Segment/date filters. No retroactive identity merge guarantee or editable CRM claim.

title: Choose and manage experiences
supportedFunctionality: Choose an appropriate guide, survey, checklist, or widget and understand Draft, Live, and Paused states.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Collection supports creation; dormant unsupported prop is not enabled. Archived status exists without an authored archive action; no archive workflow advertised.

title: Edit content, layout, and buttons
supportedFunctionality: Use the current dashboard builder to arrange blocks, change properties, configure actions, and save a draft.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Dashboard block editing verified. On-site cell-composition branches are not main. Checklist/survey structured controls preserved; no claim of general on-site block authoring.

title: Build a multistep guide
supportedFunctionality: Combine anchored and modal steps and choose how users advance through a product task.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Only anchored steps get element click/hover. Advanced progression requires entitlements. Preview/normal-delivery distinction explicit.

title: Configure contextual widgets
supportedFunctionality: Create anchored cards, toasts, modals, banners, slideouts, hotspots, and cursor followers with the right behavior.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: All routed renderer types verified. Hotspot renderer actually opens card on click despite an editor hint calling it passive. Pointer follower not presented as mobile guidance.

title: Preview and select page targets
supportedFunctionality: Open the real product safely, select reliable elements, and distinguish draft preview from normal delivery.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: SDK main live editor is placement/target/layer selection; no real screenshot or signed-in test captured. Checklist live editor endpoint is unsupported.

title: Save, review, and publish
supportedFunctionality: Review the actual launch conditions, publish a saved draft, and manage later revisions.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Review uses saved draft; draft editing keeps published version separate. No archive/rollback UI promised.

title: Create a feedback survey
supportedFunctionality: Build slides and questions, configure required answers and navigation, and launch a contextual survey.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Linear steps, six question types, required validation and button actions; answer branching unavailable.

title: Read and investigate survey responses
supportedFunctionality: Review survey participation, inspect submissions, and turn a structured answer group into a segment.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Structured response grouping only. NPS Segment groups by category, not selected exact score. Direct response-event comparison unavailable.

title: Build an onboarding checklist
supportedFunctionality: Create persistent tasks, choose task actions and completion rules, and preview the checklist states.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Stateful runtime verified separately; no ordinary trigger/frequency controls. No-action is click-to-complete, published Guide prerequisite, completion acknowledgement persists.

title: Choose who sees an experience and where
supportedFunctionality: Combine saved audiences with page rules and verify eligibility using real product context.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Page rules copied into definition; runtime origin guard. No historical audience snapshot guarantee.

title: Choose when an experience starts
supportedFunctionality: Use page arrival, a custom event, or an explicit launch action without inventing a separate workflow builder.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: No standalone Workflows route or arbitrary ordered event-workflow UI. Manual launch documented only through explicit supported actions.

title: Control repeats, scheduling, and priority
supportedFunctionality: Choose how often an experience appears and understand the checks that can delay delivery.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Interrupt behavior applies to active guide, not arbitrary widget replacement. Frequency across experience history; advanced entitlement gates.

title: Manage workspaces and sites
supportedFunctionality: Switch the active context, edit a site’s domain, and understand the effect of deletion.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Account settings read-only except sign-out; Data & Privacy informational, not operational controls. Site deletion destructive.

title: Invite teammates and manage access
supportedFunctionality: Create a private invitation link, choose a role, and maintain pending invitations.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Private invite links, not automatic email delivery. Owner/self locked; pending valid invitations occupy seats.

title: Manage your plan and usage
supportedFunctionality: Review subscription status and capacity, open Paddle billing, and understand the MAU allowance.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: No payment executed. UI, API, Paddle error path and billing-origin MAU verified in source; no price/limit table duplicated.

title: Import and review your website theme
supportedFunctionality: Scan your connected site for visual tokens, review the candidate, and activate a theme for new experiences.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Import on next SDK load; candidate approval; existing definitions are not retroactively restyled. No live theme scan performed.

title: Find an onboarding gap and guide users
supportedFunctionality: Connect events, an ordered funnel, a drop-off segment, and a targeted experience in one activation workflow.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Requires existing event implementation and suitable observation window. No causal/retention promise.

title: Introduce a feature to relevant users
supportedFunctionality: Use a non-adopter segment and contextual guidance to help people try a feature at an appropriate moment.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Non-adoption depends on correct tracking. Current-membership reports can change after adoption.

title: Collect feedback after a product task
supportedFunctionality: Connect a successful action to a short survey, inspect real responses, and create a follow-up audience.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Requires custom-event-trigger plan feature and actual export event. No text-response condition or causal diagnosis.

title: Troubleshoot missing data
supportedFunctionality: Check the site, connection, event meaning, filters, permissions, and report definitions before changing tracking.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Diagnostic instructions source checked; no live outage or production account claims.

title: Troubleshoot an experience that does not appear
supportedFunctionality: Check publication, audience, page, trigger, timing, frequency, and targets in a deliberate order.

verification.sourceReview: verified against frontend and applicable backend/SDK snapshots

limitations: Preview is not eligibility verification; persistent frequency/checklist history matters; no production mutation performed.
